snippet.title: EN - Tawa: Lost in Time - Official Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
Embark on an epic journey with Tawa, a brave little mouse lost in a prehistoric world filled with dangers. From dense jungles to towering cliffs, every step is a challenge. Will you help Tawa survive in this ancient world of dinosaurs and hidden mysteries?

🔥 This trailer showcases the Alpha version of Tawa: Lost in Time.

🚀 Join the Adventure:
🌐 Official Website: https://tawalostintime.ovh/
📺 YouTube: @drex-tawa-lost-in-time
📸 Instagram: @drexthedrake

💬 Community:
🔔 Subscribe to stay updated on the latest news!
👍 Leave a like if you enjoyed the video and share it with your friends.
💬 Let us know in the comments what you think of this prehistoric adventure!
